0.0: We're living in strange times, #b#h0##k. Take the monsters, for instance. Did you know that they're carrying #b#t3994378#s#k around with them? I didn't believe it at first, but #p9010010# insists it's the truth!
0.1: You do know about the Black Mage's commanders, right? They led the #bBlack Mage#k's armies back in the old days. Wickedly cunning and scary strong, they took over Maple World in a flash.\nAfter the five heroes beat up the Black Mage, the commanders also disappeared.
0.2: But if monsters are carrying their emblems around? Bad news, my friend. Bad news indeed. If only a strong, tough adventurer would offer to collect those Commander Emblems, we could find out what those monsters are up to...

yes.0: Fantastic! I think #b50 #t3994378#s#k is a good start. I'll meet you when you've collected them all. \n#i3994378# #t3994378# / 50

no.0: Oh? You thought I meant you, #b#h0##k? No, the kind of adventurer I need is the kind who clicks on the 'yes' button.
